ns2:section.sectionText: Online & Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. Section enrollment is limited to students in the off-campus BS in Hort program. Online scheduled virtual class sessions require that each student have reliable high-speed Internet access and either a headset with microphone or an external microphone and speakers so they may participate in class discussions. Wireless Internet is not recommended.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $391.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
